anomalies.observed: D2 (PMEG3030EP) is drawn vertically between the +5V arrow (top) and the servo power rail (bottom), with the cathode bar at the top, i.e. anode toward the servo rail and cathode toward +5V. anomalies.expected: Per the spec, D2 is a 'Diode from +5V into the servo power rail (feeding J3/J8 pin 2 and the C1–C4 bank)'; its anode must connect to +5V and its cathode to the servo rail (the same forward direction as D1, whose cathode bar correctly faces the +5V rail).

anomalies.impact: The servo power rail would never be powered from +5V (neither from the M5Stack bus nor the external 5V input), so the servos on J3/J8 would not run; the diode instead provides a backfeed path from the servo rail into the +5V rail.
